pool._comment_stagger: Seconds between starting each worker process (startup only).
pool._comment_proxy_mode: per_account = rotate proxy per account | per_worker = sticky proxy per worker.

email._comment_provider: imap = Gmail catch-all | khalidmailer = mailer.khalid.id. Prefer env KHALIDMAILER_API_KEY.
email._comment_domain: ONE key only. Single: "gumial.web.id". Multi RR: ["a.com","b.com"] or "a.com,b.com". Env: EMAIL_DOMAIN. Wildcard subdomain needs * MX → mailer.khalid.id.

browser._comment_reset: hard = kill+relaunch browser per account (clean cookies). soft = reuse process. google mode defaults hard. Env: GROK_BROWSER_RESET=hard|soft

account._comment_password: Fixed password for ALL farmed accounts (not random). Override with env GROK_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD. Saved to accounts/email_pass.txt + accounts/accounts.jsonl

farm._comment_otp_timeout: IMAP/khalidmailer OTP wait (default 55). Env: GROK_OTP_TIMEOUT_SEC. Fast fail > hang 120s.
farm._comment_signup_gap: Global min seconds between signup submits across workers (0 = off). Env: GROK_SIGNUP_GAP_SEC.
farm._comment_phase_watchdog: Warn if a phase stalls this long (worker left alive). Env: GROK_PHASE_WATCHDOG_SEC. Per-phase: GROK_PHASE_WATCHDOG_<PHASE>_SEC.

grok_cli._comment_oauth_mode: auto = PKCE on Camoufox, device SSO on Chromium (no :56121 lock). pkce | device | auto. Force Chromium PKCE: GROK_FORCE_CHROMIUM_PKCE=1
grok_cli._comment_oauth_referrer: grok-build = Grok Build / 9router grok-cli (default). cli-proxy-api = free CLI proxy style (grok-sgb). Different JWT claims / product surface.
grok_cli._comment_activate: Visit grok.com with SSO before OAuth (event-driven readiness). Prefer this over fixed settle sleep. Env: GROK_ACTIVATE_GROK_COM=0 to disable.
grok_cli._comment_settle: Legacy fixed idle AFTER activate_grok_com. Recommended 0 (activate already waits for UI). Old default was 12. Env path: convert_grok_cli_tokens.
grok_cli._comment_oauth_gap: Min seconds between OAuth mints (per-worker; cross-worker when coordination is active). Env: GROK_OAUTH_GAP_SEC.
grok_cli._comment_chat_probe_off_critical: Soft-reset browser before HTTP probe so browser is not held during probe. Env: GROK_CHAT_PROBE_OFF_CRITICAL.
grok_cli._comment_async_probe_push: false = probe+push on registration worker (default). true = enqueue durable SQLite job after OAuth; farm_tui starts probe worker. Env: GROK_ASYNC_PROBE_PUSH=1.
grok_cli._comment_probe_queue_path: SQLite path for async probe jobs. Empty = logs/probe-queue/jobs.sqlite3. Env: GROK_PROBE_QUEUE_PATH.
grok_cli._comment_async_drain_timeout: On farm finish, wait this long for pending/claimed probe jobs before exit. Env: GROK_ASYNC_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_SEC.
grok_cli._comment_inject_policy: usable: probe chat — 2xx inject ON (usable), 402/403 inject OFF (inactive/re-probe), 400 skip. all: always inject ON if tokens.
